description: Use when budget is the primary filter: returns the cheapest available events under a required max_price cap (applied to each event's starting price), cheapest first, up to 25 results; events without pricing data are excluded. City and date range are optional additional filters. Use search_events for text- or category-driven discovery instead.

max_price.description: Required. Maximum starting price in USD — events above this are excluded

name: get_deals
